fields.implementation_summary: Actions 1-7 remediation is largely implemented, including authoritative test-api validation, live ticket-state resolution, nested CLI commands, structured handoff evidence, and lock-before-finish checks. Independent review on 2026-07-14 found two remaining correctness blockers: age-only stale-lock reclamation can steal a live lock after 30 seconds and remove a successor lock, and ordinary idempotent init still rewrites a finished workspace. Action 8 remains blocked pending ownership-safe locking, finished-init immutability, deterministic race regressions, and reconciled durability claims.

fields.validation_summary: Previously reported focused suite: cargo test -p session-api -p session-cli -p session-mcp (121 passed). Restored runtime execution records resolve. This evidence is insufficient for closure because current tests do not exercise a live lock held past the stale threshold, a real finish/mutation interleaving, ordinary init after finish with byte-stability assertions, or platform-specific replacement failure behavior.
